newsitem.title: USA: Textron sets 2-for-1 split, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Textron sets 2-for-1 split, raises dividend.

text.p: Textron Inc said Wednesday its board had authorized a two-for-one stock split, payable June 1, record May 9, and raised the quarterly dividend.
The split is subject to shareholder approval of an increase in authorized shares to 500 million from 250 million, Textron said.
Textron shareholders will vote on board's recommendation at their annual meeting on April 23 in Ft. Worth, Texas, the company said.
Textron also said its board approved an increase in the regular quarterly dividend to $0.50 per share on the company's pre-split common shares -- a 14 percent increase from $0.44 per share.

The board also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.52 per per share on the company's $2.08 cumulative convertible preferred stock, series A, and $0.35 per share on the $1.40 convertible preferred dividend stock, series B.

The increased quarterly dividend on Textron's common stock and the regular dividend on the preferred stock will be paid on April 1, 1997 to holders of record at the close of business on March 14, 1997.
